Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly hypothesized that the "orchestral country pop ballad" directed by Yoann Lemoine was Taylor Swift's "Safe & Sound". This was a premature assumption not supported by the initial search results. The search results from the very first WebSurfer turn (Step 1) explicitly listed "Taylor Swift" alongside Lana Del Rey and Harry Styles as artists Woodkid had directed, but did not specify which video. The Planner jumped to the specific hypothesis of "Safe & Sound" without verifying the director credit for that specific song first, leading to a wasted search cycle. The correct path would have been to immediately verify the director of "Safe & Sound" or to look for the specific "orchestral country pop ballad" description in the Woodkid filmography, which leads to Harry Styles' "Sign of the Times" (an orchestral ballad) rather than Swift's "Safe & Sound" (which is folk/indie and directed by Roman White). The Planner's error in forming the hypothesis at Step 1 caused the subsequent confusion.
